def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    attempts = payload.get("attempts", [])
    max_attempts = payload.get("max_attempts")
    # Validate
    if not isinstance(attempts, list):
        raise ValueError("attempts must be a list")
    for i, att in enumerate(attempts):
        if not isinstance(att, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"attempt {i} not dict")
        if not all(k in att for k in ("success", "failure_signature", "reflection")):
            raise ValueError(f"attempt {i} missing keys")
        if not isinstance(att["success"], bool):
            raise ValueError(f"attempt {i} success not bool")
        if not isinstance(att["failure_signature"], str):
            raise ValueError(f"attempt {i} failure_signature not str")
        if not isinstance(att["reflection"], str):
            raise ValueError(f"attempt {i} reflection not str")
    if not isinstance(max_attempts, int):
        raise ValueError("max_attempts must be int")
    n = len(attempts)
    if n == 0:
        # No prior attempts: request first
        return {"decision": "continue", "next_index": 0, "memory_update": None}
    last = attempts[-1]
    if last["success"]:
        return {"decision": "stop_success", "next_index": -1, "memory_update": None}
    if n >= max_attempts:
        return {"decision": "stop_budget", "next_index": -1, "memory_update": None}
    # Check repeated failure_signature
    last_sig = last["failure_signature"]
    for i in range(n-1):
        if attempts[i]["failure_signature"] == last_sig:
            return {"decision": "stop_repeated_signature", "next_index": -1, "memory_update": None}
    # Continue
    reflection = last["reflection"]
    # Ensure nonempty
    if not reflection:
        raise ValueError("reflection must be nonempty when continuing")
    memory_update = {"reflection": reflection, "signature": last_sig}
    return {"decision": "continue", "next_index": n, "memory_update": memory_update}
